# hetznerrobot_server_reset (Resource)

Resets a dedicated server — once on creation, and again whenever `triggers` change. Typical use: reboot into a freshly activated `hetznerrobot_boot_rescue` by putting its `password` into `triggers`. Reading and destroying the resource do nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resets server 321 on creation and whenever the triggers change.
resource "hetznerrobot_server_reset" "reboot" {
  server_number = 321
  type          = "hw"
  triggers = {
    kernel = "6.12"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server to reset.
- `type` (String) Reset to execute: `sw` (CTRL+ALT+DEL), `hw` (hardware reset), `man` (manual reset by a technician), `power` (press the power button) or `power_long` (hold it; forces a power-off). `hetznerrobot_reset.types` lists what the server supports.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them runs the action again (the resource is replaced).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Records "<server_number>/<type>" without resetting anything.
tofu import hetznerrobot_server_reset.reboot 321/hw
```
